_comment: Phase 71 example article — SUBSURFACE. The defining observable is LIGHT BLEEDING THROUGH: the stone glows softly where it is thin. Maps stay pale and low-contrast so the SCATTER is what you see, not the albedo. `subsurface_weight` must be nonzero — the master multiplies the scatter colour by it (default 0 = plain opaque stone). `subsurface_radius` is the length scale in cm; `_radius_scale` is the per-channel MFP (red travels furthest in stone, hence the warm falloff). Routes by the `marble` leaf-stem name exception (class stone -> Opaque otherwise).
name: Marble_Veined_Polished_Base_s01_v01
